scope: The supplied export was confirmed by the project owner as records within the London Borough of Hammersmith & Fulham. Only aggregated bird names, dates and record counts are retained; recorder names and coordinates are not published.
attribution: NBN Trust (2026). The National Biodiversity Network (NBN) Atlas. https://nbnatlas.org/ (accessed 10 October 2026).
Records provided by Birda, dataset “Birda - Global Observation Dataset (UK records)”, accessed through the NBN Atlas (CC-BY).
Records provided by British Trust for Ornithology, dataset “Birds (BTO/JNCC/RSPB partnership)”, accessed through the NBN Atlas (OGL).
Records provided by British Trust for Ornithology, dataset “Birds (BTO+partners) 2016 - 2020”, accessed through the NBN Atlas (CC-BY-NC).
Records provided by British Trust for Ornithology, dataset “Birds (BTO+partners) 2021 - 2023”, accessed through the NBN Atlas (CC-BY-NC).
Records provided by MammalWeb, dataset “MammalWeb records Non-Commercial (pre-2024)”, accessed through the NBN Atlas (CC-BY-NC).
notes: Counts are occurrence records, not individual bird totals.
A record in a month shows that a bird was recorded then; no record does not establish absence.
The archive provides historical borough-wide timing context and is not a list of named eBird hotspot records.
CC-BY-NC records are included for this non-commercial community project. Keep this dataset and resulting display non-commercial and retain attribution.
